title: Lido's LEGO grants program is missing from registry/programs
summary: Lido's own site describes LEGO (Lido Ecosystem Grants Organisation), a tiered grants program funding individuals/projects that benefit the Lido protocol and broader Ethereum PoS/DeFi ecosystem: Sandgrain (up to $1k, single approver), Pebble (up to $10k, two members), Boulder (up to $100k, council vote), Mountain ($100k+, DAO vote). An 8-member LEGO Council runs domain tracks with ~15,000 LDO-equivalent quarterly capacity each; applicants pitch a committee member via Telegram, then proposals move to research.lido.fi for review. Not currently a registry/programs entry.

programs/lido-lego.yaml.summary: LEGO (Lido Ecosystem Grants Organisation) funds individuals and projects benefiting the Lido protocol and broader Ethereum PoS/DeFi ecosystem, via a tiered structure (Sandgrain up to $1,000; Pebble up to $10,000; Boulder up to $100,000; Mountain $100,000+) overseen by an 8-member LEGO Council with domain-specific tracks. Applicants pitch a committee member directly rather than through an open-form apply page.

title: Taiko's current $25M Grant Cycle 3 is missing a registry/programs entry with round detail
summary: Taiko's grant page names its active funding round 'Taiko Grant Cycle 3: $25M to Support Community Builders and Partners', covering DeFi, AI, RWA, SocialFi, gaming/NFTs, and other categories, rolling applications via an Airtable form, milestone-based and non-dilutive. Applicants must complete legal/KYC agreements and open-source code (unless otherwise agreed). No dedicated program file exists yet even though the org file (taiko-grant-program) tracks the same funder; a program entry would let cycle-level rounds be tracked over time (Cycle 2 ran in 2023).

programs/taiko-grants.yaml.summary: Taiko's community grants program funds builders in DeFi, AI, RWA, SocialFi, gaming, and core ecosystem categories, milestone-based and non-dilutive. Current round is Grant Cycle 3 ($25M), rolling applications via GitHub or the program portal; prior rounds include Cycle 2 (2023).

title: XRPL Accelerator's own site lists Cohort 5-7 dates/partners not yet in the registry program's rounds
summary: The XRPL Accelerator page lists three named, dated cohorts (rounds list in the registry program is currently empty): Cohort 5 (Mar 10-May 16 2025, with a DIFC partnership), Cohort 6 (Jun 9-Aug 15 2025), and Cohort 7 (Sep-Nov 2025). All three are hybrid 12-week formats admitting 5-12 teams, up to $200k funding each. Given today's date, all three cohorts have concluded.
